comment: The Video Builder component (ADR-0077, V1a): a pinned Node.js, the pinned Chrome headless shell for Testing, and the packages in video_builder/package-lock.json (hyperframes 0.8.171, gsap 3.15.0), each fetched only after the person has seen the size and confirmed it. Only Apple-silicon Macs are measured (docs/spikes/video-builder-v0.md); other systems say so in words.

shell.licence: Chromium (BSD-3-Clause and bundled third-party licences, see LICENSE.headless_shell in the download)

packages.note: 130 packages (two of them carry FFmpeg 4.4 and ffprobe 4.4.1 for darwin-arm64: a GPL build, run only as separate programs); Apache-2.0, MIT, ISC, BSD, CC0, 0BSD, SIL OFL-1.1 (the two font packages), the gsap Standard no charge licence, and one LGPL-3.0-or-later prebuilt library (libvips inside sharp) that is used as shipped and not modified
